nvitk.morphology.centerline
===========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.morphology.centerline

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Centerline utilities (skeletonize + polyline ordering).

   These helpers are **not** GPU-native: scikit-image's 3D skeletonization is CPU
   only. We accept CuPy arrays by converting to NumPy via :func:`nvitk.core.array.to_numpy`.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.morphology.centerline.skeletonize_binary

   nvitk.morphology.centerline.compute_centerline_branches
   nvitk.morphology.centerline.compute_centerlines
   nvitk.morphology.centerline.centerline_tangents


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: skeletonize_binary(mask) -> Any

   3D/2D skeletonization (CPU skimage; returns backend array of bool).


.. py:function:: skeletonize_labeled(mask, *, labels: Sequence[int] | None = None, min_points: int = 1) -> Any

   Skeletonize each label region independently; output keeps original label ids.

   For a binary mask (labels ``[1]``), skeleton voxels are written as ``1``.
   For multilabel masks, each label's skeleton voxels carry that label's id.


.. py:function:: unique_skeleton_edge_polylines(coords_xyz: np.ndarray, *, min_points: int = 2, prune_short_spurs: bool = False, prune_spur_points: int = 3) -> list[np.ndarray]

   Unique centerline edges between endpoints and junctions (no interior overlap).

   Each returned polyline is a chain between skeleton specials (deg≤1 endpoints
   and deg≥3 junction clusters). Chains share only their junction endpoints so
   the union is a connected tree/graph without duplicated trunks.


.. py:function:: compute_connected_centerline_tree(vessel_mask: np.ndarray, *, centerline_mask: np.ndarray | None = None, labels: Sequence[int] | None = None, min_points: int = 2, min_edge_points: int = 2, keep_all_components: bool = True, bridge_max_gap: int = 0, bridge_tube_radius: int = 1, prune_short_spurs: bool = True, prune_spur_points: int = 3) -> dict[int, list[np.ndarray]]

   Per-label connected centerline tree as unique skeleton-edge polylines.

   This is the **default branched centerline representation** for nvitk:
   skeletonize each label, optionally MST-bridge nearby mask CCs, then extract
   every unique junction↔endpoint / junction↔junction chain. Edges share only
   junction voxels (no overlapping trunks). All meaningful skeleton CCs are
   kept by default so proximal roots are not dropped.

   :returns: Label → list of ordered ``(N, 3)`` polylines in voxel coordinates.
   :rtype: dict[int, list[np.ndarray]]


.. py:function:: compute_centerline_branches(vessel_mask: np.ndarray, *, centerline_mask: np.ndarray | None = None, labels: Sequence[int] | None = None, min_points: int = 20, min_branch_points: int = 3, prefer_points_by_label: dict[int, np.ndarray] | None = None, keep_all_components: bool = True, bridge_max_gap: int = 0, bridge_tube_radius: int = 1, connected_edges: bool = False) -> dict[int, list[np.ndarray]]

   Per-label list of branch polylines.

   Default (*connected_edges=False*): trunk + bifurcation side branches per
   skeleton CC (legacy qvtpy / vertebral-split semantics).

   With *connected_edges=True*: unique junction-split edges from
   :func:`compute_connected_centerline_tree` (preferred for morphometrics and
   any export that must stay connected at bifurcations without overlapping
   trunks).

   All skeleton CCs are kept by default (*keep_all_components*).


.. py:function:: compute_centerlines(vessel_mask: np.ndarray, *, centerline_mask: np.ndarray | None = None, labels: Sequence[int] | None = None, min_points: int = 20, prefer_points_by_label: dict[int, np.ndarray] | None = None, keep_all_components: bool = False, bridge_max_gap: int = 0, bridge_tube_radius: int = 1) -> dict[int, np.ndarray]

   Return per-label ordered centerline points in voxel coordinates.

   For a single main path per label (graph diameter on the largest skeleton CC
   by default). For branched vessels that must stay connected at bifurcations
   without overlapping trunks, use :func:`compute_connected_centerline_tree`.

   :param vessel_mask: 3D integer label mask (NumPy or CuPy).
   :param centerline_mask: Optional 3D mask where centerline voxels are >0. If provided, this mask is
                           intersected with each `vessel_mask == label` region and ordered.
   :param labels: Optional explicit label list. Default: all non-zero labels in `vessel_mask`.
   :param min_points: Skip labels whose centerline has fewer than this many voxels.
   :param prefer_points_by_label: Optional prior polylines (e.g. stage-3) used to keep proximal trunks on
                                  branched skeletons instead of a distal-only graph diameter.
   :param keep_all_components: If True, concatenate diameter paths from every skeleton CC (first = largest).
                               Default False preserves historical single-path behaviour.
   :param bridge_max_gap: If >0, MST-bridge nearby mask CCs of each label before skeletonize.


.. py:function:: centerline_tangents(points_xyz: Any, *, k_half: int = 2) -> Any

   Unit tangent vectors along an ordered polyline (voxel coordinates).

   Uses central differences with ``k_half`` samples on each side; endpoints
   use one-sided differences. ``points_xyz`` shape ``(N, 3)``.
